lines: In 1492, Vijayanagara seemed fragile, torn by coup and war while northern sultanates pressed inward.
By 1500, general Tuluva Narasa Nayaka seized control, securing vital territories from Karnataka to Rameshwaram.
By 1530, legendary emperor Krishnadevaraya crushed Bijapur at Raichur and expanded across southern India.
Vijayanagara stood as southern India's supreme power. Did its rulers build India's greatest medieval capital?
title: How the Vijayanagara Empire Ruled Southern India 👑
description:
Discover how the Vijayanagara Empire expanded to dominate southern India during its golden age. Follow its border growth from crisis to peak under Krishnadevaraya.
